recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中多數細胞為核呈折疊、分葉或腦回狀的單核球，胞質灰藍、含細顆粒與小空泡，邊緣有胞質突起（blebs），夾雜骨髓細胞與少數小淋巴球，呈現單核球系明顯增生，符合 CMML。
features: Many monocytes with folded, convoluted, or lobulated nuclei
Fine to moderately condensed chromatin; nucleoli inconspicuous
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, small vacuoles, and cytoplasmic blebs
Admixed granulocytic precursors (myelocytes, metamyelocytes) and occasional band forms
Rare small lymphocytes; blast-like cells few
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows numerous monocytes with folded, convoluted, and lobulated nuclei, fine to moderately condensed chromatin, and abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with fine azurophilic granules, small vacuoles, and irregular cytoplasmic blebs. Granulocytic precursors and occasional small lymphocytes are admixed. Blasts and promonocytes do not predominate in this field. Findings are consistent with a monocytic and granulocytic proliferation, supporting chronic myelomonocytic leukemia in conjunction with peripheral blood monocytosis and exclusion of BCR::ABL1.

ddx.vs: Would show ≥20% monoblasts/promonocytes with fine chromatin and prominent nucleoli, whereas most cells here are mature monocytes.
Lacks dysplasia and clonal genetic abnormalities; monocytes are usually less numerous in the marrow.

ddx.dx: Chronic myeloid leukemia with monocytosis (p190 BCR::ABL1)
ddx.vs: Requires BCR::ABL1 testing, as morphology alone cannot exclude it.
